card.name: Linking words before 'use' in risk statements
card.fires_on: The word 'of' after 'duration' in NSAID cardiovascular warnings, and 'or' or a comma in lists of factors raising risk (large areas, occlusion, prolonged use).

modes.label: Duration of use
modes.description: The word 'of' after 'duration' in the boxed cardiovascular risk warning.
modes.example: This risk may occur early in treatment and may increase with duration<< of>> use (5.1) . SY

modes.label: Risk-factor lists
modes.description: A linking 'or' or comma between factors that raise the chance of HPA axis suppression from topical steroids.
modes.example: High potency corticosteroids, large treatment surface areas<<,>> prolonged use, use of occlusive dress

card.writes: It suppresses time-span words like years and decades, so the next word is less likely to be a length of time.
card.plain: It marks a small linking word in warnings about longer or heavier use raising risk, where a time span is not what comes next.
